1. Services

Provider will design, implement, and maintain the document delivery service described in the attached statement of work. Deliverables include source review, integration support, and a production handover.

2. Responsibilities

  1. Client will provide timely access to test data and a named technical contact.
  2. Provider will keep project materials confidential and report material delivery risks.
  3. Both parties will review acceptance criteria before a release is marked complete.

3. Fees and term

The fixed implementation fee is 18,400.00 EUR, payable in two equal instalments. The agreement continues for twelve months and renews only by written agreement.

Notice: Either party may terminate for material breach after thirty days' written notice and an opportunity to cure.

4. Governing agreement

This agreement and its statement of work form the complete understanding between the parties. Amendments must be signed by authorised representatives.
